chestnut: On cold evenings, we love to roast chestnuts over the fire.
在寒冷的夜晚，我们喜欢在火上烤栗子。
ideally: Ideally, we should finish the report before the meeting starts.
理想情况下，我们应该在会议开始前完成报告。
prism: The glass prism split the sunlight into seven bright colors.
玻璃棱镜把阳光分解成七种明亮的颜色。
analogue: Some scientists consider the dolphin to be an analogue of early human society.
一些科学家认为海豚是人类早期社会的类似物。
idleness: Long idleness made him lose interest in almost everything he once enjoyed.
长期的懒散让他对曾经喜爱的一切几乎都失去了兴趣。
rapture: She gazed at the northern lights in silent rapture.
她欣喜若狂地凝视着北极光。
rapidity: The rapidity of the city's growth surprised even the oldest residents.
这座城市发展的迅速程度连最老的居民都感到惊讶。
bitterness: He spoke of his failure with great bitterness in his voice.
他带着极大的辛酸谈起自己的失败。
fastener: The coat's metal fastener broke, so she couldn't keep warm.
大衣的金属扣件坏了，所以她没法保暖。
peacock: The peacock opened its beautiful tail to attract the attention of visitors.
孔雀展开美丽的尾羽来吸引游客的注意。
pneumatic: The mechanic repaired the pneumatic brake of the old bus.
机械师修理了这辆旧公交车的气动刹车。
adjustable: This chair has an adjustable back, so it suits people of different heights.
这把椅子的靠背可以调节，所以适合不同身高的人。
frightful: The frightful noise of thunder kept the children awake all night.
可怕的雷声让孩子们整夜都没睡着。
monstrous: Building a factory next to the school seems a monstrous idea.
在学校旁边建工厂似乎是个极其糟糕的主意。
respectable: Mr. Lee is a respectable teacher who never laughs at his students.
李先生是一位可敬的老师，从不嘲笑学生。
shameful: Cheating in the exam was a shameful act for the whole class.
考试作弊是让全班都蒙羞的可耻行为。
unlock: She used the spare key to unlock the office door this morning.
今天早上她用备用钥匙打开了办公室的门。
sheriff: The sheriff promised to search the forest for the missing boy.
郡治安官承诺搜寻森林，寻找失踪的男孩。
winding: They drove slowly along the winding road that led to the mountain village.
他们沿着通往山村蜿蜒曲折的公路缓缓行驶。
Christ: Millions of Christians around the world celebrate the birth of Christ every December.
全世界数百万基督徒每年十二月庆祝基督的诞生。
warning: The weather station issued a warning about the coming heavy storm.
气象站发布了关于即将来袭强风暴的警告。
refinery: The oil refinery near the harbor provides jobs for thousands of workers.
港口附近的炼油厂为数千名工人提供了工作。
astonishment: To my astonishment, the shy boy won first prize in the speech contest.
令我惊讶的是，那个害羞的男孩在演讲比赛中获得了一等奖。
prohibition: The prohibition on smoking in public places has improved the city's air.
公共场所的禁烟令改善了这座城市的空气。
tuna: I often make sandwiches with canned tuna and fresh vegetables.
我经常用金枪鱼罐头和新鲜蔬菜做三明治。
tuberculosis: Better nutrition and new medicines have greatly reduced tuberculosis in this region.
更好的营养和新药物大大减少了该地区的结核病。
economically: Many families are struggling economically because prices keep rising.
由于物价不断上涨，许多家庭在经济上都很困难。
soy: This soup gets its rich flavor from soy beans and mushrooms.
这道汤的浓郁味道来自大豆和蘑菇。
degradation: The degradation of the soil made it impossible to grow crops there.
土壤的退化使那里无法种植庄稼。
firmness: She answered the question with calm firmness, and nobody argued further.
她以沉着坚定的态度回答了问题，没有人再争论。
insistent: The salesman was so insistent that I finally agreed to look at the product.
推销员一再坚持，我最后同意看一看那个产品。
sham: His apology turned out to be a sham, and he soon made the same mistake.
他的道歉原来是假的，他很快就又犯了同样的错误。
fowl: The farmer keeps chickens, ducks, and other fowl behind the barn.
农夫在谷仓后面养鸡、鸭和其他家禽。
lodging: We found cheap lodging near the station for our three-day trip.
我们在车站附近找到了便宜的住处，用于三天的旅行。
geometrical: The garden is designed in a geometrical pattern of circles and squares.
这座花园被设计成圆形和方形的几何图案。
bazaar: We bought spices and hand-made baskets at the crowded bazaar.
我们在拥挤的集市上买了香料和手工篮子。
gathering: A large gathering of neighbors came to celebrate the old couple's birthday.
一大批邻居聚集在一起庆祝这对老夫妇的生日。
elemental: The film shows the elemental struggle between humans and the sea.
这部电影展示了人类与海洋之间最基本的斗争。
vigour: Although he is seventy, the old scientist still works with great vigour.
虽然已经七十岁了，这位老科学家仍然精力充沛地工作。
mixer: My mother uses an electric mixer to make the cake dough faster.
我妈妈用电动搅拌器来更快地做好蛋糕面团。
